references.text: The same construction of carrying poles made of acacia wood for the incense altar, which were also overlaid with gold.
God's instructions to Moses to make carrying poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold for the ark of the covenant.
The instruction to make carrying poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold for the table of showbread.
Carrying poles made of acacia wood for the altar of burnt offering, which were overlaid with bronze.
A parallel description of how Bezalel made carrying poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold for the ark of the covenant.
The same type of construction of carrying poles for the table of showbread, made of acacia wood and overlaid with gold.
Carrying poles made of acacia wood for the altar of burnt offering in the courtyard.
Connects the original divine instruction with the actual, obedient execution of the same command.
